name: Generate lists of fictional game items and equipment
description: Users asked the AI to generate lists, tables, or detailed systems for fictional game items, equipment, loot, and magic objects within tabletop and video game settings. Many requests focused on specific, often absurd or humorous themes such as diaper-centric mechanics or oversized body parts, while others involved standard RPG elements like weapons, armor, crafting materials, and guild systems.
